units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sukkah 5:6">Succ. V, 6</cite> <he>בש׳</he> on the seventh day of Succoth.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 29:11">Lev. R. s. 29</cite> <he>ש׳ חביב</he> the seventh thing is most precious; a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="U00129"><he>שְׁבִיעִין</he></cite>.
Ib. כל הש׳ וכ׳ all seventh things are precious.—Fem. שְׁבִיעִית Ib.; a. fr.—Esp. the seventh year, Sabbatical year.

<cite ref="Mishnah Sheviit 1:1">Shebi. I, 1</cite> <he>ערב ש׳</he> the year preceding the Sabbatical year; <cite ref="Mishnah Sheviit 1:4">ib. 4</cite> <he>מוצאי ש׳</he>, v. <cite ref="M00573"><he>מוֹצָא</he> III</cite>.

Snh. III, 3 סוחרי ש׳ traders in fruits of the Sabbatical year; a. v. fr.—Pl. שְׁבִיעִיּוֹת. Y. ib. 21ᵃ bot. שתי ש׳ we must wait for two Sabbatical years before reinstating the trader in Sabbatical fruits in his civic rights; Y. Shebu. VII, 37ᵈ bot. (not שני).—Sh’biʿith, name of a treatise, of the Order of Z’raʿim, of Mishnah, Tosefta, and Talmud Y’rushalmi.
